name: Marcus Collins
source:
Media is not an ordinary businessman. If you take some time to research him, you'll find his name in places you would never expect. On any given day you can find him running one of his many businesses. He works weekends, and has a particular taste for coffee. Media is well liked by the public, due to a tightly curated presentation of himself. Self-assured, smart, and wealthy, Media says he's just looking for someone that shares his ambitions and passions. But maybe there's something else he wants...

[From Kickstarter]
